jobs.description_text: WHY JOIN ALO? Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That’s the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life. OVERVIEW: The Senior Manager, Safety is responsible for leading the execution and advancement of safety strategy across Alo’s distribution center network. This role provides leadership and oversight for safety programs, processes, performance, and safety teams while partnering closely with distribution center and cross-functional leadership. The Senior Manager balances strategic program development with hands-on field leadership to establish consistent standards, mitigate operational risk, strengthen safety ownership, and build scalable systems that support Alo’s continued growth. RESPONSIBILITIES: Lead the execution of Alo’s safety strategy across the distribution center network, ensuring consistent standards and practices while accounting for site-specific operational needs. Partner with the Director of Safety & Operations Training to develop, implement, and continuously improve scalable safety programs, standards, processes, and systems. OVERVIEW: The Sr. Manager, Production Control owns production planning strategy and execution across all distribution centers in the Alo Yoga network. This role is responsible for establishing consistent planning methodologies, standards, and best practices while leading site-level Production Planning Managers to drive operational consistency, throughput optimization, and service level performance. This is a highly strategic and operational role requiring expert knowledge of production planning, warehouse operations, demand forecasting, WMS systems, and supply chain analytics. The role demands strong leadership capability, financial acumen, and the ability to influence and align stakeholders across multiple distribution centers and functional partners. jobs.title: Senior Supplier Industrialization Engineer, Electromagnetic Warfare
jobs.department: Hardware Operations : Supply Chain : Product Sourcing Engineering
jobs.description_text: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. ABOUT THE JOB The Senior Supplier Industrialization Engineer (SIE), Electrical is a high-profile, cross-functional position focused on enabling development and production flow of Anduril's critical Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) supply base. You will work in close coordination with internal engineering, quality, supply chain, and manufacturing departments as well as directly with suppliers to execute effective, creative, and smart supply chain strategies to achieve production goals. We're looking for a talented Senior Supplier Industrialization Engineer to expedite the qualification and implementation of product designs with our suppliers, optimizing these designs for quality, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness from early development through the entire product lifecyc
